[[Category:Inventory]]
In [[inventory]] management, the '''reorder point''' ($I_{ROP}$) is the physical inventory when an order must be made to prevent [[stockout]].

In general,

$$
I_{ROP}=\int^{t_s} D(t) dt + I_S
$$

<div class=center>
{| class="wikitable"
|-
| $t_s$
| Expected order-to-delivery time
|-
| $D(t)$
| The demand function
|-
| $I_S$
| [[Safety inventory]]
|}
</div>
